Who are We
 mindit.io is an AI-driven custom software services company with +250 IT specialists with proven expertise in software & product engineering, artificial intelligence, business intelligence, data analytics & integration services.
With offices in Switzerland, Germany and 4 delivery centers in Romania, we cover the entire development cycle from business research, consulting, and architecture to post-implementation testing and maintenance.
 Our Values
Partner of choice: With a customer-centric approach, we build an environment where partnerships thrive and turn them into long-lasting relations. It’s a space of co-creation, innovation, and top-notch technologies to deliver outstanding custom software development
Professional: We always deliver and this is one non-negotiable pillar of our culture. Be it product engineering or custom software development, the quality and ethics of our work are inherent to everything we do
Authentic: We value everyone’s uniqueness in the pursuit of framing a culture of equality, diversity, and inclusion. Come as you are and stay true to yourself. We become the best version of ourselves together
Team: Trust is our ultimate currency, and we use it to constantly enrich our kind community. When it comes to scaling, the team is our functional cell. We grow together, we learn together, we build together
 Responsibilities
Build, test, and deploy new front-end features and maintain existing functionality using Vue and Quasar
Work closely with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to deliver user-friendly and performant applications
Design reusable components and ensure consistency in styling and functionality through tools like Storybook
Utilize ESLint and Prettier for code quality and style, and implement tools like Lint Staged and Husky for automated code style checks
Use Vue i18n for implementing internationalization across the application
Manage shared state using Pinia to ensure smooth data handling across components
Follow structured commit practices using Commitizen and Conventional Changelog for clean and organized version control
 Write and maintain tests using Vitest to ensure high code reliability and performance.
Use Hygen for code generation and maintain comprehensive documentation for easy onboarding and consistent development practices
 What Are We Looking For
5+ years of experience in frontend development, working with Vue.js in a professional setting
Strong experience with Quasar or similar component libraries and frameworks
Proficient in TypeScript with a deep understanding of its application within frontend development
Hands-on experience with Vue Router for client-side routing and Pinia (or Vuex) for state management
Practical knowledge of Vue i18n for supporting multi-language applications
Experience with modern frontend tooling, including Vite for development and builds, Vitest for testing, Storybook for component documentation, and Hygen for code generation
Excellent understanding of ESLint, Prettier, Commitizen, Conventional Changelog, Lint Staged, and Husky for maintaining code quality and streamlining commit processes
